content: Jesu yo Isana Aiyetwa no Weeli
Jesu yoli ba likamba no lisa lya Genesaleta, aanu sebeli amusheeteta onene nji ayupe eliywi lya Nyambe.
Cwale sebeli omona amato ayiili mu lisa, kono ayambi natundumo mi alemine oku yowisanga otunyandi too.
Jesu sebeli oingena mu wato omunjili wa Simoni, sebeli omwambela nji aufule kanyonyo okutunda ba likamba. Cwale sebeli oikala banji ni kwiyeta aanu no kupula yoli mu wato.
Cwale aba ana kumana okwamba sebeli wambela Simoni nji, “Obeeke aba no kutunga onene mi oyambe otunyandi towe.”
Cwale Simoni sebeli otambula nji, “Molyange, natu yamba ousiku wonje kono kakwisa esi tuna wana. Kono okuta mu liywii lyowe kame niyamba otunyandi.”
Cwale aba ana kutenda ngeeso, sebeli akuuya elibunda linene no tindi, mane akanyandi sebeli ka kauka.
Cwale sebeli akobeta alikani oo nji aiye mukwaatusa. Cwale sebeli aiya ni kwiiyata amato ayiili mane sebeli atateka okutika.
Kono Simoni Pitolosi abana kumona ngeeso, sebeli okukwiseta banji ni manwi aye kwa Jesu ni kwamba nji, “Otunde kwa mene, kakuli mene kame nili osiku tenda eibi, Mbumu!”
Mulibaka elyo kame ana kukomoka onene naawo ana kwikala naye ba ku mona okupula no tindi anaku kuuya.
Cwale sebeli ku tendahala ngeeso ni kwa Jacobo ni Jowani aana a Zebedeya, alikani a Simoni, mi Jesu sebeli wambakwa Simoni nji “Olese ku cila, okutunda bano mbuyamba aanu.”
Cwale aba ana kulita amato oo ku likamba, sebeli asiya einu yonje ni ku mukon̄a
Jesu yo Balisa Omulume

Jesu yoli mu mulenen̄i munjili, sebeli kwiiya omulume osi kutoma embingwa, mi aba ana kumona Jesu, sebeli okwela banji ni lubala lwaye ni kwamba nji, “Mbumu, nji kame osinga, kame otwesa okuni balisa!”
Cwale Jesu sebeli oolola elyoko lyaye ni ku mulema ni kwamba nji, “Nisinga, obale!” Mi ababo embingwa sebeli ibwa.
Cwale sebeli omulaelela nji alese okwambela omunu, “Kono ote oka kumonahalise kwa mupulisita, mi olite enubu no ku balisiwa kanyi omu ana ku laelela Mushe, itende oupaki kwaanu.”
Kono cwale elibubo lyaye sebeli lihasana, mi aanu no kupula sebeli aungana oku muteeteteta ni ku balisiwa ku meeti oo.
Kono sebeli ota mu lihalaupa oka lapela.
Jesu yo Balisa osi Lun̄an̄ali

Ba liywaa elinjili yo iyeta, kame kuna kwikala Afalisi na iyeti no mulawo awo nakwiiya okutunda mu mindi yonje no Galileya ni Judeya ni mu Jelusalema, mi amaata a Mbumu kame ana kwikala kwa yonyene oku balisa aanu.
Komumone, sebeli kwiiya alume ashimbile omulume ba saala osi lun̄an̄ali, mi sebeli akumbela oku mwingenyika mukaci ni ku mu langeka ba lubala lwa Jesu.
Kono kasi kuwana esibaka no kwingena, mulibaka no aanu okupula, sebeli atina ba lituwa no ndoo ni ku mu shulumukiseta ni saala saye mukaci no aanu balubala lwa Jesu.
Cwale Jesu aba ana kumona etumelo yoo, sebeli wamba nji, “Mulume, eibi yowe na wilemenwe.”
Cwale aiyeti no mulawo na Falisi sebeli atangisa okwibanguta aamba nji, “Anyine wuyu mulume woyo wamba mu malimbuluti? Woyo so twesa okulemena eibi konji feela konji Nyambe yomboci.”
Cwale Jesu aba ana kulimuka etipuzo too, sebeli waatambula nji, “Ngasibine aba mukwibanguta mu micima yenu?
Sibine esi sootobile, okwamba nji, ‘Eibi yowe nwilemenwe,’ ni kwamba nji, ‘Oimane mi weende?’

Kono nji mulimuke nji Omwana no munu kame akwite etukelo no kulemena eibi bano banji.” sebeli wambela omulume osi lun̄an̄ali nji, “Kame nikwambela nji, oimane, oshimbe oulangano wowe mi ote ku mundi!”
Cwale ababo sebeli oimana ba lubala loo onje, ni ku shimba oulangano waye, ni kuta ku mundi waye yo yeema Nyambe.
Sebeli akomoka onene onje, ni ku yeema Nyambe mane sebeli aiyala okucila aamba nji, “Balelo na tumono einu indina no ku komokisa!”
Jesu yo Isana Lebi
Eyo aba ina kubwa, Jesu sebeli otundamo, mi sebeli omona Lebi omutelisi yo ikalile ba ofisi no mutelo, mi sebeli omwambela nji, “Onikon̄e.”
Cwale Lebi sebeli osiya einu yonje, ni ku mu kon̄a
Cwale Lebi sebeli otendeliwa omukiti no kuneneba mu ndoo yaye, mi kame kuna kwikala atelisi anjili no kupula naanjili ana kwikala noo ku tafule.
Cwale Afalisi naa iyeti no mulawo sebeli an̄un̄uta ni kwambela aiyetwa aye nji, “Iikene aba mulya ni kunwa na telisi na sikutenda eibi?”
Cwale Jesu sebeli waatambula nji, “Aanu awo ayoya wino kasaele onganga, kono awo atomine okame amusaela.
Kani siiya mu kwisana awo alukile, kono awo asikutenda eibi nji abake.”
Epuzo kweyo no ouku Yumena Eilya
Cwale aanu sebeli aamba kwa Jesu nji, “Aiyetwa a Jowani aka no kupula kame aku yumenanga eilya mi kame alapelanga, na iyetwa no Afalisi kame atendanga ngeeso, kono aiyetwa owe kame alya ni kunwa.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli waambela nji, “Kame ku twesahala nji alikani no mukwati aku yumene eilya omukwati yoli noo?
Amaywaa mba iiyi omukwati aba sa tundisiwe kwa onyene, mi cwale kame saaku yumene eilya mu maywaa awo.”

Jesu kame sebeli waambela enguli injili nji, “Kakwisa omunu otwesa oku tundisa esimanahanyi ba sikumango no ubya nji asi beeke ba sikumango no ku kulubala. Nji atende ngeeso, mba kaula esikumango no ubya, mi esimanahanyi no ubya kasi tamba oku lumelelana ni sikumango noku kulubala.
Kakwisa omunu otwesa oku beeka ewaine no ubya mu sindunga no ku umbiwa ba itumba no ku kulubala, nji atende ngeeso, ewaine no ubya mbai kaula eitumba mane ni kwiteka, ni itumba mbai sinyehe.
Kono ewaine no ubya kame ifanena okwibeeka mu indunga no kuumbiwa ba itumba no ubya.
Cwale kakwisa omunu so tateka okunwa ewaine no kale nji asinge eyi no ubya, kakuli kame saambe nji, ‘Ewaine no kale ya kuwaba okubita eyi no ubya.”
